This name signifies the presence of the divine being in the form of the moon, which is considered a powerful symbol of change, renewal, and protection. The name Mohideen carries the meaning “Moon God” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi. Parents who choose Mohideen usually hope their child will grow to embody moon god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
